concerns.text: T021 (check_input_drift) depends on `data/processed/baseline_vectors.csv` from T015, but T021 is marked [P] (parallel-safe). If T021 runs in parallel with T015, it will fail to find the input artifact. The [P] tag is incorrect; T021 must strictly follow T015.

T024a (perturbation sweep) depends on `data/processed/baseline_vectors.csv` from T015. It is marked [P] (parallel-safe). Parallel execution with T015 would cause a race condition or missing file error. The [P] tag is invalid.

T030 (generate_per_task_trade_off) depends on `data/processed/validity_log.csv` from T024a. It is marked [P] (parallel-safe). T030 cannot run until T024a completes and writes the log. The [P] tag is invalid.

T030b (aggregate_global_results) depends on `data/processed/validity_log.csv` from T024a (and implicitly T030). It is marked [P]. This task cannot run in parallel with T024a or T030. The [P] tag is invalid.

T031 (analysis orchestration) depends on filtered vectors and validity logs produced by T024a/T030. It is marked [P]. This is a consumer task that must wait for the entire US2/US3 data pipeline to complete. The [P] tag is invalid.

Phase O tasks (T040-T043) are marked [P] and described as runnable in parallel with User Stories. However, T040 (sampling strategy) and T041 (error handling) modify `data_loader.py` and `perturbation.py` which are core to US1/US2. If T040 runs in parallel with T006/T013, it creates a file conflict. These should be sequential or clearly scoped to avoid file-level race conditions.
